abstention_rule: No hyperparameter, feature, threshold, bin, or mapping tuning after the battery runs. If variant B (EXP-FP-0071) fails the win gates, that IS the finding: a negative-results entry with the mechanism of failure, then variant C preregistered as EXP-FP-0072 with its own fresh seeds. Never re-tune-and-rerun under the same ID.

baseline.formula: p_i^c = (1 + sum_{j<i} o_j) / (2 + (i-1)) -- Laplace-smoothed running base rate over PAST outcomes only, per domain, per seed
baseline.name: sequential_climatology

coupling_target.definition: corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) per domain, pooled over seeds; u = 1-p for D1/D2/D4, u = p for D3; error channels identical to CALIB-01/0070

decision_tree.if: Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains AND corr>=0.40 on >=3/4 domains
decision_tree.then: SUCCESS -- genuine calibrated competence estimator (PROTOTYPE; not INTEGRATED until wired into the live act() path)

decision_tree.if: Brier win on >=3/4 but coupling gate fails
decision_tree.then: PARTIAL -- beats climatology but uncertainty still uncoupled; negative-results entry; variant C targets coupling
NULL_HOLDS -- variant B is theater too; negative-results entry with mechanism; variant C preregistered fresh

estimator_design.causality_rule: Unchanged from 0070: predict tick t from history < t + tick-t prediction-time fields only; train after emission. The four new features are all captured from _pending at _open_tick time (or e1_ema from the previous close) -- known BEFORE the outcome. Sidecar write is observational.
estimator_design.estimator: competence_estimator.CompetenceEstimator feature_mode='B' (online logistic + log-linear, climatology-anchored, normalized SGD eta_p=0.1/eta_e=0.05, ehat exponent clipped [-7,3])
estimator_design.features_added: [mean_similarity, n_nbrs/5, retrieval_used(0/1), log1p(e1_ema)] appended to every domain's feature vector (D4 keeps uhat first, then the four novelty features)
estimator_design.features_kept: all seven variant-A features (error-history EMAs, z-surprise, logit(climo) anchor, log1p(stated_unc), fast event-rate, lagged update_norm)
estimator_design.mechanism_hypothesis: EXP-FP-0070's negative measured changing_rule |err| as nearly temporally i.i.d. (lag-1 autocorr 0.13, decaying to ~0 by lag 5; no post-flip episode transient) -- error HISTORY therefore carries almost no signal, which is why variant A's history features failed. The predictable component of error magnitude must come from the CURRENT tick's context: episodic-memory novelty (low mean_similarity / few neighbors -> the generative model faces an unfamiliar observation -> larger |e0|), retrieval application, and the L1 error-scale state. These are the agent's own prediction-time competence cues.
estimator_design.why_not_theater: Same anti-theater instruments as 0070: climatology-anchored online learning (starts AS the baseline), prequential evaluation, corr>=0.40 coupling gate, anchor-only + permutation kill arms.

gates.degenerate_base_rate: base rate of o outside [0.02, 0.98] -> UNMEASURABLE

hypothesis: Adding the agent's prediction-time novelty/state context (mean_similarity, n_nbrs, retrieval_used, e1_ema) to the causal online estimator couples it to actual error magnitude: Brier beats sequential climatology on >=3 of 4 domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) >= 0.40 on >=3 of 4 domains, on fresh changing_rule runs.

instrumentation.additivity: prototypes/architecture-b/instrumented_arch_b.py defines InstrumentedArchB(ArchB): overrides _close_tick ONLY to snapshot prediction-time context into a sidecar JSONL, then delegates to super(). agent.py, predictions.py and all core files byte-identical (G0).
instrumentation.equivalence_check_prerun: one seed run with both ArchB and InstrumentedArchB; the PredictionLog JSONL outputs must be byte-identical (proves the instrumentation is behaviorally inert)

kill_attempt_preregistered: Same two kill arms as 0070 on the same 4 seeds: (1) anchor-only (learn=False) reproduces Brier_climo to 1e-9; (2) error-permutation decomposition -- intact < permuted < climo ordering expected (error-history features add independent signal beyond fast base-rate). ADDITIONAL ablation for variant B: novelty-features-zeroed replay (sidecar fields forced to 0) -- if the win vanishes, the novelty features are the load-bearing component.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule), closed-loop; conditional on the visited distribution.
PROTOTYPE status: causal replay over recorded streams (PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar); not wired into the live act() path.
The climatology anchor means early-tick predictions equal the baseline by construction; the pooled prequential Brier includes the learning transient honestly.

metric.Brier_climo: sequential Laplace running base rate per domain per seed (identical formula)
metric.Brier_est: mean((p_i - o_i)^2), p_i from causal prequential replay with mode-B features
metric.ECE: 10 equal-width bins, reported (full CALIBRATED = Brier win AND ECE<=0.10 AND MCE<=0.25, reported not gated)

never_self_report: The estimator consumes ONLY recorded PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar context (prediction-time fields) plus causally derived history. No agent self-assessment is an input; no outcome from tick t (or later) enters tick t's prediction.
null: Brier_est >= Brier_climo on every domain AND/OR corr < 0.40 on every domain -- the novelty features carry no competence information (variant B is theater too).

runs.agent: InstrumentedArchB (additive subclass of arch_b; behavior-equivalence checked pre-run), PredictionLog + sidecar JSONL per seed
runs.condition: changing_rule v1.0.0, 10 episodes per seed, canonical derive_seed streams
runs.fresh_seed_justification: 73205, 73206, 73208, 73209: word-boundary grep over the flesh-pits tree finds zero prior use (73207 IS used in old BAR logs -- skipped deliberately)

variant_budget: variant C (0072) remains if 0071 fails; each variant preregistered separately with fresh seeds
